title: Prime Geospatial
text: We bridge the gap between complex spatial monitoring data and actionable environmental decision-support tools. Our team specializes in remote sensing pipelines, automated data cleaning workflows, and spatiotemporal modeling.

title: Prime Geospatial
text:
Primary Areas of Expertise



🛰️ Remote Sensing & Land-Cover
We build automated analytical systems using satellite imagery archives to track fine-scale environmental and ecosystem dynamics over time.





📊 Data Optimization Pipelines
We transform unstructured, messy, or scaled spatial data arrays into organized, open-access, reproducible computational workflows.






🖥️ Spatial Decision Tools
We design software packages and web interfaces that integrate complex environmental models directly into planning and management pipelines.





🌲 Landscape Architecture
We calculate spatial fragmentation metrics and run advanced predictive models to help clients assess habitat suitability and long-term climate resilience.

title: Contact Prime Geospatial
Projects & Applications
text:
Our operational models are built on free, reproducible, open-access workflows.

🌍 Automated Coastal Ecosystem Monitoring Tool
A cloud-based pipeline leveraging public satellite archives and Google Earth Engine to track regional land-cover dynamics and coastal changes across the Caribbean. * **Core Stack:** Python, Google Earth Engine API, JavaScript


🦎 Habitat Suitability Analytics Engine
An open-source modeling suite built to clean raw animal sighting metrics and calculate complex landscape fragmentation values. * **Core Stack:** R (`sf`, `terra`), Git-backed version management
